### [Italian electricity demand — forecasting from the ground up](projects/energy-demand/index.qmd)

Public Terna load data, coverage checks, and a measured national benchmark.
Across 11,520 observations in four complete months of 2026, the weekly naive
forecast had 1,369 MW MAE versus 567 MW for Terna's published forecast. The
comparison is reproducible and the next modeling steps are clearly marked as
work in progress.

::: {.stack}
Python · pandas · time series · Terna public API
